description: This file defines the feature for deleting comments in the Conduit application. It includes the command, validator, and the handler logic to remove a comment based on its ID and the associated article's slug.

classes.name: Delete.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validates that the command's Slug is not null or empty.

classes.name: Delete.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the deletion of a comment by its ID and article slug, including database retrieval, validation, and removal.

methods.name: Delete.QueryHandler.Handle
methods.description: Executes the process to find the article and comment, throw exceptions if not found, and delete the comment from the database.
